Loss-of-function mutations in APC (causative for FAP) and CHD8 (associated with developmental disorders) both lead to dysregulation of the Wnt signaling pathway. In FAP, APC's role in degrading beta-catenin is lost, leading to its accumulation and Wnt pathway activation, driving intestinal polyposis.
